name: TLE2141 / TLE2142 / TLE2144
tagline: TI Excalibur part: 10.5 nV/√Hz, 5.9 MHz, up to ±22 V, drives 10 nF; found in some high-end DAC output stages.

lineage.note: Excalibur complementary-bipolar line. Per-device datasheets first; combined TLE214x/TLE214xA sheet SLOS183 from 1997-02.
PCN20250730004.1 (2025-07-31): RFAB fab added, die rev B→C, SLOS183D→SLOS183E; first ship 2025-10-29.

part_numbers.note: Single. Listed in PCN20250730004 (July 2025 fab/die transition).
Dual, the audio-relevant member. C/I/M temperature grades. Lifecycle not explicitly confirmed.
Tighter-precision dual; TI link ti.com/lit/gpn/TLE2142A exists.
Quad. Product page exists; lifecycle not explicitly confirmed.
Automotive-qualified; own datasheet, literature number unknown. Lifecycle unconfirmed.
Enhanced Product; separate datasheet on alldatasheet.
Enhanced Product quad; separate datasheet on alldatasheet.
Military-temperature and '-D' die/wafer products with TI product pages.
Chip form, in the old standalone datasheet. Likely obsolete (unconfirmed).

reputation.summary: Niche and lightly discussed. A Head-Fi poster says a 4300-euro Acoustic Arts DAC uses eight TLE2142s in its output stage (unverified). One user liked its tonality, body and bass; another preferred the LM4562. There is no broad consensus.
typical_uses: DAC output stages (Acoustic Arts DAC, reportedly)
Op-amp rolling in headphone amps and DACs
High-rail line stages up to ±22 V
caveats: Praise is sparse and mixed; one Head-Fi user preferred the LM4562.
Parts from late October 2025 may be die rev C (RFAB); no comparisons with die B yet.
The Acoustic Arts DAC claim is second-hand from a forum post.

counterfeit_notes: No specific counterfeit reports. Buy from authorized distributors, as with other TI DIP op-amps sold on marketplaces. Genuine stock from late October 2025 on may be die revision C from RFAB.

part_numbers_affected: TLE2142 (likely; same SLOS183 datasheet, not explicitly confirmed)
silicon_changes.identification: Die rev C and RFAB fab codes on reel/box labels; date codes after late October 2025; datasheet SLOS183E. Dallas die-B stock may ship in parallel.
silicon_changes.summary: TI added RFAB (Richardson, TIB process) as a fab alongside DL-LIN (Dallas): die revision B to C, datasheet SLOS183D to SLOS183E, new assembly BOM options. Part of TI's move off 200 mm fabs. First ship 29 Oct 2025. TI expects no form, fit, function or reliability impact.
silicon_changes.audio_impact: Unknown. A new die on a different process could change noise, distortion or stability. No measurements or listening comparisons found.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: medium: new die and process under same part number; SLOS183E tables not yet compared with rev D.
silicon_changes.verification: PCN lists TLE2141; TLE2142 and TLE2144 inclusion likely but not explicit.

revision_history.changes: Pre-1997 per-device edition with TLE2142Y. Text cites 'patent-pending' input, 6-Hz 1/f corner, 40 V/µs into 800 pF; later text says 10 Hz (unconfirmed).
First combined TLE214x/TLE214xA family datasheet, replacing the per-device sheets.
Last old format. Front page: 10.5 nV/√Hz, 15 nV/√Hz at 10 Hz, 10,000 pF, 20 mA, 27 V/µs, 5.9 MHz, 500 µV Vio.
New TI format, issued under PCN20250730004 (RFAB fab, die B→C, BOM options). Spec-table changes not seen.

claims_confirmed: Family datasheet SLOS183 'TLE214x, TLE214xA Excalibur...'; rev D Feb 1997, revised Oct 2012 (https://www.radiolocman.com/datasheet/data.html?%2FTLE2142=&di=330795).
Current SLOS183E dated July 2025, new format (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/slos183e/slos183e.pdf).

PCN20250730004.1 (31 Jul 2025, first ship 29 Oct 2025): RFAB/TIB added, die B→C, TLE2141 datasheet SLOS183D→E, no anticipated impact (https://mm.digikey.com/Volume0/opasdata/d220001/medias/docus/7170/PCN20250730004.1.pdf).
10.5 nV/√Hz, 15 nV/√Hz at 10 Hz, 5.9 MHz, 27 V/µs, 340–400 ns settling, 150 ns recovery, 20 mA, 10,000 pF (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tle2142.pdf).
Performance largely supply-independent over ±2 V to ±22 V (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tle2142.pdf).
Older standalone 'TLE2142, TLE2142A, TLE2142Y' datasheet exists on a mirror (https://www.icbase.com/File/PDF/TTI/TTI20590106.pdf).
TLE2142-Q1 has its own TI datasheet and product page (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tle2142-q1.pdf).
TI product pages exist for TLE2142AM, TLE2142AM-D and TLE2142M-D (https://www.ti.com/product/TLE2142AM-D).
corrections: TLE2142 set to 2 channels; added TLE2141, TLE2144, A grades, -Q1, -EP, AM/M-D and Y chip version.
Technology corrected from 'precision bipolar dual' to complementary-bipolar Excalibur, single/dual/quad.
Filled datasheets, revision history, key specs, silicon changes, lineage, SLOS183 and archive seeds.
